forms.name: Petrified Strongarm
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Charge
Blade for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Strongarm
forms.text:
The Petrified Strongarm's final
form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless efforts.

forms.name: Sophos Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Poison Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that incorporates
the poison sac of a Gypceros to
quickly eliminate its prey.

forms.name: Venom's Kiss
forms.text:
The final form of the Poison
Blade, its poisonous edge is an
utter nightmare for opponents.

forms.name: Hell Venom Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poison Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Type 31 Wyvernslayer
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of tough
Nibelsnarf materials. Its blade
brings a swift end to opponents.

forms.name: Reactive Border
forms.text:
The Type 31 Wyvernslayer's
final form. It is a highly
refined version of the original.

forms.name: Composite Border
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 31 Wyvernslayer</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from a
beautiful fossil. The stone is
still shiny despite its age.

forms.name: Relic Blade
forms.text:
The Obsidian Strongarm's final
form. Its ancient power razes the
earth as it attacks the enemy.

forms.name: Ethereal Statera
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Strongarm
forms.text:
A Brachydios Charge Blade whose
sturdy, blast-proof materials
make it a potent weapon.

forms.name: Volatile Blade
forms.text:
The Dios Strongarm's final
form. It channels even more
explosive force into its strikes.

forms.name: Explosive Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Blade
forms.text:
A Brachydios Charge Blade whose
innate heat cuts into prey and
makes its blood burst.

forms.name: Fulgent Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Blade's final
form. It uses its intense internal
heat to cover the land in flames.

forms.name: Fulgent Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak C. Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose inner fire
begs for freedom so that it might
set its rage upon the world.

forms.name: Lightbreak Vent
forms.text:
The Lightbreak C. Blade's final form.
Its inner anger explodes with
limitless power, destroying all.

forms.name: Lightbreak Unleasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Lava's Veil
forms.text:
A Lavasioth Charge Blade imbued
with pure magma. When its crater
opens, foes don't stand a chance.

forms.name: Crater Blade
forms.text:
The final form of the Lava's
Veil, it summons forth a hellfire
that douses the land in flames.

forms.name: Volclatero Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava's Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Elite Blade
forms.text:
A well-forged steel Charge Blade.
It was once used by a champion
in countless battles.

forms.name: Kaiser Blade
forms.text:
The Elite Blade's final form.
It is a high-class weapon, made
from only the finest materials.

forms.name: Kaiser Kommandant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elite Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Rogue Axe
forms.text:
A blade with a striking red and
green pattern, the Maccao scales
are a sign of a veteran hunter.

forms.name: Dashing Rogue
forms.text:
The Rogue Axe's final form. It
retains the flashy design, but ups
performance across the board.

forms.name: Dashing Bandit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rogue Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Snowy Veil
forms.text:
A Charge Blade affixed with
monster hide, its stripes
providing it with camouflage.

forms.name: Frosted Veil
forms.text:
The Snowy Veil's final form.
With its dull shine, the assassin's
blade greets its doomed prey.

forms.name: Pure Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snowy Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Horror Zofar
forms.text:
A blade with a Malfestio-inspired
design. Sword and shield pair to
form wings that spirit away prey.

forms.name: Dormant Wings
forms.text:
The Horror Zofar's final form.
A dreamy sky endlessly unfolds
as the Malfestio spreads its wings.

forms.name: Zofar Wings
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Horror Zofar</COL>.

forms.name: Barroth Anchor
forms.text:
An earthy Charge Blade made from
a Barroth. Its hardness offers both
protection and smashing ability.

forms.name: Rugged Anchor
forms.text:
The Barroth Anchor's final form.
The shield is hardened further to
provide unrivaled protection.

forms.name: Barroth Reanchor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barroth Anchor</COL>.

forms.name: Blackguard
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made for the
general public. Casuals love
the heavy, stately design.

forms.name: Full Blackguard
forms.text:
The Blackguard's final form.
It retains its casual appearance
while greatly increasing power.

forms.name: Schwarzschild
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackguard</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrex Divide
forms.text:
A Tigrex Charge Blade, its sharp
fangs and talons wait for an
opportunity to strike at its prey.

forms.name: Tigrex Blade
forms.text:
The Tigrex Divide's final form.
It opens its mouth and lets out
cruel laughter, taunting foes.

forms.name: Huge Tigrex Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrex Divide</COL>.

forms.name: Sentinel Blade
forms.text:
A standard Charge Blade with
a classy design and elemental
properties worked into it.

forms.name: Noblest of Lieges
forms.text:
The Sentinel Blade's final
form. Its refined looks hide the
powerful blasts it is able to fire.

forms.name: Noblest of Victories
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sentinel Blade</COL>.

forms.name: K. Captain's Blade
forms.text:
A dignified Charge Blade bearing
the sigil of a knight-captain who
charged foes with electric force.

forms.name: Die Walküre
forms.text:
The K. Captain's Blade's final
form. Named for a mighty female
warrior, it has won many battles.

forms.name: Tristan and Isolde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>K. Captain's Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Dear Lutemis
forms.text:
A Rathian Charge Blade, it houses
an uncommon evil. Its thorns are
a sign of the queen's personality.

forms.name: Dear Lutemia
forms.text:
The final form of Dear
Lutemis. Its beauty is sublime
yet severe at the same time.

forms.name: Dear Lutemineva
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dear Lutemis</COL>.

forms.name: Luna Eostre
forms.text:
A Charge Blade housing the golden
Moon Goddess, who opens her gate
in the sky to shine down mercy.

forms.name: Glimmering Eostre
forms.text:
The Luna Eostre's final form.
It rises like the moon to bathe
the earth in purifying flame.

forms.name: Luna Crucible
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Luna Eostre</COL>.

forms.name: Guardsqual
forms.text:
Forbidden jaws open when
shield becomes axe and drag
prey into a hopeless abyss.

forms.name: Squaliarma
forms.text:
The Guardsqual's final form.
When the Zamtrios's jaws open,
its prey meets a painful death.

forms.name: Squaliarmada
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardsqual</COL>.

forms.name: Serrated Glace
forms.text:
A blade with a special mechanism
that creates a garden of razors
which blossom along the edge.

forms.name: Trios Tristesse
forms.text:
The Serrated Glace's final
form is a beautiful blood-soaked
blade that sows seeds of despair.

forms.name: Tristesse Durera
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Serrated Glace</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Blade
forms.text:
A simple Charge Blade carved
from a monster bone that is the
basis of similarly styled weapons.

forms.name: Bonesilt Veil
forms.text:
The Bone Blade's final form.
Its upgrades have given rise to
a harsh and heroic weapon.

forms.name: Bonebreaker Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Desertfall
forms.text:
A Cephadrome Charge Blade, it
uses a paralytic agent as well as
a fin for offense and defense.

forms.name: Desert Sidefin
forms.text:
The final form of Desertfall. A
storm generated by its slashes can
swallow all that stand before it.

forms.name: Desert Death
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Desertfall</COL>.

forms.name: Aslat Charger
forms.text:
A lovely Seregios Charge Blade.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Rebellious Charger
forms.text:
The Aslat Charger's final
form. A spirit of revolution lies
within its golden blade.

forms.name: Aslat Revolution
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aslat Charger</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Blade
forms.text:
An implement of beauty and death.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Garuda Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Blade's final
form. Its blade pointed skyward
signals the time for rebellion.

forms.name: Sedition Severer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Guardian Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade worn by the guard
of a ruler. It switches between
offense and defense effortlessly.

forms.name: Nadegiri
forms.text:
The Guardian Blade's final
form. It strikes down any who
threaten the wielder's master.

forms.name: Ceanataur Nadegiri
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardian Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Schildsect
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that uses the
rigidity of a shell for powerful
offense and robust defense.

forms.name: Galvanisect
forms.text:
The Schildsect's final form. Its
refined shell adds further
strength and Sharpness.

forms.name: Excelsisect
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Schildsect</COL>.

forms.name: Dominisect
forms.text:
A blade recognizable by its
sharp, red horns, which serve as
a dire warning and direr weapon.

forms.name: Maximinsect
forms.text:
The Dominisect's final form,
its red horns instill fear as
they pulverize the enemy.

forms.name: Apex Predator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dominisect</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Strongarm
forms.text:
A desert tyrant that kicks up
clouds of sand with each
cataclysmic strike.

forms.name: Cera Strongarm
forms.text:
The Diablos Strongarm's final form.
Smashes life with an explosion of
uncontainable anger.

forms.name: Cera Cediment
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Axelion Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Rathalos materials.
Facilitates igniting attacks.

forms.name: Bardichion Blade
forms.text:
The Axelion Blade's final form.
The face carved into the shield is
a representation of pure rage.

forms.name: Amgalion Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axelion Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Hellsire Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
rare and precious materials.
Ignites with more force.

forms.name: Hellspawn Blade
forms.text:
The Hellsire Blade's final form.
It emits rays of silvery sun that
punish foes with godly fury.

forms.name: Rathflame Ubernova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hellsire Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Blossomauler
forms.text:
A Charge Blade imbued with the
fire wyverns' brilliance. Gold
and silver fire bloom within.

forms.name: Propensity
forms.text:
The Blossomauler's final form.
A bright blast of profusive flames
reduces everything to ashes.

forms.name: Cornucopia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blossomauler</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Storm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of Lagiacrus
materials. Signals the start of a
hunt with the roar of thunder.

forms.name: Vankrom Blade
forms.text:
The final upgrade of Lagia
Storm. It features the power of
a Lagiacrus, ruler of the seas.

forms.name: Vankrom Voltblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Storm</COL>.

forms.name: Arachnoscale
forms.text:
A blade that uses its Nerscylla
parts to good visual effect. Has
a unique anti-friction mechanism.

forms.name: Arachnoscythe
forms.text:
The Arachnoscale's final form.
Can cut through the hardest shells
like a hot knife through butter.

forms.name: Belobog's Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arachnoscale</COL>.

forms.name: Poisonous Veil
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that features a
poisonous sac. Its dark blade
instills dread in the enemy.

forms.name: Infected Veil
forms.text:
The Poisonous Veil's final
form. Its deadly toxin creates
chaos that knows no end.

forms.name: Malefico Veil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poisonous Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Cuddly Cat
forms.text:
Don't be fooled by this cat-based
blade. The hairs on its back are
able to cut through wyvern hide.

forms.name: Felyne Fancy
forms.text:
The Cuddly Cat's final form.
It has been continually refined,
almost as if its hair was petted.

forms.name: Ominous Puss
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cuddly Cat</COL>.

forms.name: Pizzaxe
forms.text:
This versatile Charge Blade is
perfect for slicing up delicious
pizza or vicious monsters.

forms.name: Pizza Wheel
forms.text:
Made for pizza lovers of all ages,
this is the final form of the
Pizzaxe. Buon Appetito!

forms.name: Deluxe Pizzaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pizzaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Chameleos C. Blade
forms.text:
A blade based on a mysterious
status and designed to worship
the fascinating Chameleos.

forms.name: Chameleos Edge
forms.text:
The Chameleos C. Blade's final
form. This blade is a divine force,
paralyzing foes with its dance.

forms.name: Chameleos Miasma
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chameleos C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Mizuniya Drill
forms.text:
An elegant Charge Blade known
for its tendency to stain its foes'
clothing a deep blood red.

forms.name: Final Fieldblade
forms.text:
The Mizuniya Drill's final form.
It generates a sea of crimson, with
none left standing in its wake.

forms.name: Divine Fieldblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mizuniya Drill</COL>.

forms.name: Axela Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from Astalos
materials. It is capable of using
Thunder attacks.

forms.name: Harbarex Blade
forms.text:
The Axela Blade's final form.
The image carved into its shield is
a sign of the Astalos's electric rage.

forms.name: Amagarex Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axela Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade said to have been
used by an ancient warrior. It is
even capable of razing mountains.

forms.name: Colossus's Edge
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Edge. A lone warrior once used
it to overcome impossible odds.

forms.name: Behemoth's Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Demander
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that combines
the flames of a Glavenus as its
shield, and the tail as its sword.

forms.name: Glavenus Bardred
forms.text:
The Scorching Demander's final
form. It attacks with the force of
hellfire and brimstone.

forms.name: Glavenus Bardnova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Demander</COL>.

forms.name: Elendskraft
Leidenskraft
forms.text:
The final form of Elendskraft.
It invites its victims to journey to
dark and hellish depths.

forms.name: Unheilskraft
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elendskraft</COL>.

forms.name: L'Oppresseur
L'Essor
forms.text:
The final form of L'Oppresseur.
It cleanses the soul by bringing
the light of life to the darkness.

forms.name: Le Salut
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Oppresseur</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Casca
forms.text:
A Kushala Daora Charge Blade
from the distant north. Its
divine shape repels disasters.

forms.name: Daora's Thwartoise
forms.text:
Daora's Casca's final form.
It is referred to as a tool of the
gods by northern mythology.

forms.name: Daora's Worldbearer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Casca</COL>.

forms.name: Wicked Edge
forms.text:
A hideous Charge Blade that
reaps its victims' souls with a
single sweep of its tail.

forms.name: Malevolent Blade
forms.text:
The Wicked Edge's final
form. It exists to strike down all
in the name of desolation.

forms.name: Menkar Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wicked Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Gant Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that serves as
a guide in the night sky once
its tail appears.

forms.name: Cosmic Edge
forms.text:
The Gant Blade's final
form, it ushers in a desolate
wind to cover the land.

forms.name: Sirius Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gant Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Vaik Veil
forms.text:
A blade that uses an incredibly
tough shell to cut through the
thickest wyvern hide.

forms.name: Shieldraad
forms.text:
The Vaik Veil's final form.
This blade more than earns its
keep when hunting in the field.

forms.name: Armordraad
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vaik Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Mandible Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from the
tough jaws of a Butterfly Beetle.
Its spines rip into flesh and bone.

forms.name: Maxilla Edge
forms.text:
The Mandible Blade's final
form. It has been sharpened to
the limit without losing strength.

forms.name: Skull Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mandible Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Black Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that harbors a
dark power inside, its shield
reveals its wielder's true form.

forms.name: Onyx Strongarm
forms.text:
The Black Strongarm's final
form, this blade has sacrificed
countless souls to the darkness.

forms.name: Fatalis Charger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Blade
forms.text:
A brawny Rajang Charge Blade.
Its golden trails symbolize power
that even gods and monsters fear.

forms.name: Demonlord Supersurge
forms.text:
The Demonlord Blade's final
form. A Rajang soul inside it can
transform into pure demonic rage.

forms.name: Demonlord Eradicator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Hero Strongarm
forms.text:
A weapon that has always gone
forth in search of new opponents
since ancient times.

forms.name: Master Strongarm
forms.text:
The Hero Strongarm's final
form. It disappeared for a time
before its rebirth.

forms.name: Legend Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Research Blade
forms.text:
A handy Charge Blade put together
by the Soaratorium eggheads to
navigate the skies during the night.

forms.name: Discovery Blade
forms.text:
The Research Blade's final form.
As a wise man once said, the
answers are written in the stars.

forms.name: Authority Teleblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Charge Fox
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon, its
splendid fox design can look
like either sword or shield.

forms.name: Press Corps Axe
forms.text:
The Charge Fox's final form,
designed with a breath-
taking interplay of color.

forms.name: Confidante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Charge Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Legendary Anchor J
forms.text:
An anchor used by the master
of the seven seas. It carved
the path to a new world.

forms.name: Legendary Legacy J
forms.text:
The Legendary Anchor J's final
form. The anchor is heavy
with the hopes for the future.

forms.name: Legendary Strongarm J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Legendary Anchor J</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor C. Blade
forms.text:
A blade that houses a black-
hearted god. Its searing heat
begs to be unleashed and conquer.

forms.name: Akantor Severance
forms.text:
The Akantor C. Blade's final
form, it openly declares one's
ambition to conquer the land.

forms.name: Akantor Supremacy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Altostratus Blade
forms.text:
A Charge Blade belonging to the
sun god. It will return the earth
to dust when it shines its light.

forms.name: Celestial Vortex
forms.text:
The Altostratus Blade's final
form. It showers the masses in
the light of hope and salvation.

forms.name: Universal Vortex
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Altostratus Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Edge
forms.text:
Shines with the Argent Comet's
silvery hue. As dense as an iron star,
its shredding attacks are merciless.

forms.name: Dragonstar Tenag
forms.text:
The Silverwing Edge's final form.
"Fear me, the star-cruncher; thus do
mighty supergiants become dust."

forms.name: Magnastar Tobah
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Strongarm
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Charge Blade for
hunters breaking new ground.
Solid both in defense and attack.

forms.name: Sage Strongarm
forms.text:
The Elder Strongarm's final form.
The strong blade fends off dragons,
punching through their tough hide.

forms.name: Philosopher Strongarm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Strongarm</COL>.

forms.name: Chili Axe
forms.text:
Want to breathe fire for real?
You'll need something spicy! Help
yourself to some spicing and slicing!

forms.name: Jalapeno Axe
forms.text:
The Chili Axe's final form.
The king of spiciness is here!
Now with spicier flame breath!

forms.name: Scotch Bonnet Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chili Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Elends/Essor
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Gefunden/Ruine
forms.text:
The Elends/Essor's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would stop decay.

forms.name: Friede/Désastre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elends/Essor</COL>.

forms.name: Vermilion Veil
forms.text:
Only dragon slayers are allowed
to use this weapon, but those who
do can wipe out dragons easily.

forms.name: Draconic Veil
forms.text:
The Vermilion Veil's final form.
One hit can separate the heavens
from the earth.

forms.name: Sealed Dragonveil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vermilion Veil</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Edge
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of night, clad
in a soulless robe.

forms.name: Inscribed Nephthys
forms.text:
The Gold Edge's final form.
Created by the bringer of night and
death's mistress, Nephthys.

forms.name: Nebethetepet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade that houses an
Alatreon spirit. Its dark power brings
madness and self-destruction.

forms.name: Alatreon Morphblade
forms.text:
The Alatreon Edge's final form. Raw
madness rouses the Alatreon's spirit,
awakening the darkness within.

forms.name: Altheos Transmutation
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Reaver
forms.text:
The crimson dragon's ruinous
power, which the Guild has
secretly learned to harness.

forms.name: True Ruiner Reaver
forms.text:
The Ruiner Reaver's final form.
It takes strength and courage to
wield a weapon that brings despair.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner Dawn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Reaver</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Mien
forms.text:
An ancient Fatalis blade that
ascends from hell with brutal
force in search of a sacrifice.

forms.name: Fatalis Demeanor
forms.text:
The Fatalis Mien's final form. No
matter how much it is drenched in
gore, the blade still shimmers.

forms.name: Fatalis Countenance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Mien</COL>.

forms.name: Dear Regina
forms.text:
A blade made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dearest Regina
forms.text:
The final form of Dear Regina.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dear Regina Nobis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dear Regina</COL>!

forms.name: Dreaded Blade
forms.text:
A blade made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking's Path
forms.text:
The Dreaded Blade's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Darkflame Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreaded Blade</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Divide
forms.text:
A blade made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Rider
forms.text:
The Rudra Divide's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Biter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Divide</COL>!

forms.name: Ashen Demander
forms.text:
A blade made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ashen Bardredd
forms.text:
The Ashen Demander's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Ashen Bardredd Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ashen Demander</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made of
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Gloom
forms.text:
The Cloaked Edge's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Twilight
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Slasher
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Relentless Slasher
forms.text:
The Razor Slasher's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Slasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Slasher</COL>!

forms.name: Fugitive Hours
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Red-Clad Rebellion
forms.text:
The Fugitive Hours's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Adoration Unwound
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fugitive Hours</COL>!

forms.name: Axebolt Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Axebolt Cleaver
forms.text:
The Axebolt Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Maxbolt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axebolt Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Edge
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Warder
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Animosity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Strongarm
forms.text:
A Charge Blade made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Enforcer
forms.text:
The Massacre Strongarm's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Column Buster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Strongarm</COL>!

forms.name: Worn C. Blade
forms.text:
A worn Charge Blade with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered C. Blade
forms.text:
The Worn C. Blade's final form.
Further altering this incomparable
masterwork would be abominable.

forms.name: Aged C. Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn C. Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Chrono Gear
forms.text:
An ancient Charge Blade that
has had its gears restored via
modern technology and parts.

forms.name: Ionian Gear
forms.text:
The Chrono Gear's final form.
Its gears of destiny count down
to the end of days.

forms.name: Tourbillon Gear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chrono Gear</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Striker
forms.text:
A Charge Blade whose power blasts
hell's gates off their hinges
with the Flame Emperor's ire.

forms.name: Teostra's Nova
forms.text:
The final form of Teostra's
Striker. It serves as the gates
to purgatory, expelling evil.

forms.name: Teostra's Redeemer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Striker</COL>.
